name: House Velkonn
role: A Velar High House of the Imperial Loyalist camp
description: A High House (noble clan) of the Velar Imperium. Per the Velar social order, High Houses wield ancestral power, command legacy fleets and hold ancient artifacts; House Velkonn holds all three — it fields the Velkonn House Fleet and maintains an ancestral citadel among the Velar House seats.

assets.fleet: Velkonn House Fleet — the House’s legacy fleet, listed in source under the Imperial Loyalists alongside Sira Velkonn.
assets.seat: An ancestral citadel, attested as one of the Velar House seats. No coordinate is established; not placed.

lineage_marker: Vel- — royal or noble lineage, per polity_velar_imperium.naming_conventions.

known_members.char_talyx_velkonn: Exiled Grand Duke, Velar Imperial restorationist

membership_note: The three canonical Velkonn characters share the house name and all read as nobility, which is what the Vel- lineage prefix predicts. Shared house membership is recorded as the evident reading; no kinship relation between them is asserted, because no source establishes one.
